source.rationale: THE FAMILY OUTLIVES THE ROSTER (captain 2026-08-24). picker_families maps a picked candidate to the ACCOUNTS it stands for; the block above keeps it only while the picker ROSTER is alive, but the PIN is not bound to that lifetime - an entity keeps its uuid for as long as the customer keeps talking about it. Measured, exec 13695546 vs 13695091: the roster expired, the family went with it, and the pick then covered 1 account instead of the 12 the picker had measured. Here the customer is two turns past the pick - the roster is gone from session state, the customer pin is carried, and this turn names a product - so the main block writes no picker_* keys at all and the carry is the only thing that can keep the family. Stage A deleted this block as 'no producer, no consumer'; disallowed-entity-gate's G-A produces picker_families and G-B consumes it back off get-session-vars, so both premises are now false.
